description: Foundation business English for absolute beginners. Students learn survival-level workplace communication: introductions, describing their job, basic office interactions, simple requests, and essential phone/email phrases.

chapters.description: Learn to introduce yourself, your coworkers, and talk about basic personal/professional information.

lessons.name: Pleased to Meet You
lessons.goalEn: Can introduce yourself and your coworker.
lessons.situation: A new coworker joins your team. Introduce yourself and another coworker to him/her.
lessons.goalKr: 자기소개와 동료 소개를 할 수 있게 된다.

lessons.name: All About Me
lessons.goalEn: Can read and understand a simple self-introduction profile.
lessons.situation: You read a short profile card that a new coworker shared with the team.
lessons.goalKr: 간단한 자기소개 프로필을 읽고 이해할 수 있다.

lessons.name: Tell Me About Yourself
lessons.goalEn: Can talk about yourself using basic personal information.
lessons.situation: At a welcome lunch, your new coworkers ask you about yourself.
lessons.goalKr: 기본적인 개인 정보를 사용하여 자신에 대해 말할 수 있다.

lessons.name: Who's Who?
lessons.goalEn: Can introduce team members and describe their roles.
lessons.situation: A client visits your office. Introduce your team members to the client.
lessons.goalKr: 팀원을 소개하고 역할을 설명할 수 있다.

lessons.name: First Impressions
lessons.goalEn: Can use self-introductions and team introductions confidently.
lessons.situation: Review scenarios: meeting new coworkers, reading profiles, introducing team members.
lessons.goalKr: 자기소개와 팀 소개를 자신 있게 할 수 있다.

lessons.name: Nice Office!
lessons.goalEn: Can understand when someone describes their workplace.
lessons.situation: A coworker gives you a tour of the office on your first day.
lessons.goalKr: 직장에 대해 이야기하는 것을 들을 수 있다.

lessons.name: The Company Directory
lessons.goalEn: Can read simple employee profiles in a company directory.
lessons.situation: You look at the company directory to learn about your new colleagues.
lessons.goalKr: 사원 명부의 간단한 프로필을 읽을 수 있다.

lessons.name: Where Are You From?
lessons.goalEn: Can ask and answer questions about personal background.
targetPatterns: How long have you worked here?
lessons.situation: During a coffee break, you chat with a coworker and learn about each other.
lessons.goalKr: 개인 경력에 대해 질문하거나 대답할 수 있다.

lessons.name: Let's Keep in Touch
lessons.goalEn: Can exchange contact information with a coworker.
lessons.situation: After meeting new coworkers, you want to exchange contact information.
lessons.goalKr: 동료와 연락처를 교환할 수 있다.

lessons.name: Our New Team
lessons.goalEn: Can handle all basic introduction and networking conversations.
lessons.situation: Comprehensive review: team introductions, office tour, exchanging contact info.
lessons.goalKr: 기본적인 소개와 네트워킹 대화에 대응할 수 있다.

chapters.description: Learn to navigate and describe the office environment, ask for and give simple directions, and talk about office equipment.

lessons.name: Where Is the Printer?
lessons.goalEn: Can understand simple directions inside an office.
lessons.situation: You need to find the printer. A coworker gives you directions.
lessons.goalKr: 사무실 내 간단한 길 안내를 들을 수 있다.

lessons.name: The Office Map
lessons.goalEn: Can read and understand a simple office floor plan.
lessons.situation: You look at the office floor plan to find different rooms and facilities.
lessons.goalKr: 간단한 사무실 층 지도를 읽고 이해할 수 있다.

lessons.name: Can You Help Me Find It?
lessons.goalEn: Can ask for directions to places in the office.
lessons.situation: It's your second day. You need to find the break room, supply closet, and HR office.
lessons.goalKr: 사무실 내 장소로 가는 길을 물을 수 있다.

lessons.name: It's Over There
lessons.goalEn: Can give simple directions to places in the office.
lessons.situation: A new employee asks you for directions to different rooms.
lessons.goalKr: 사무실 내 장소로의 간단한 길 안내를 할 수 있다.

lessons.name: Office Tour
lessons.goalEn: Can ask for and give directions confidently in the office.
lessons.situation: Give a complete office tour to a visitor, then answer their questions.
lessons.goalKr: 사무실 내에서 자신 있게 길 안내 질문과 답변을 할 수 있다.

lessons.name: How Does This Work?
lessons.goalEn: Can understand simple instructions for using office equipment.
lessons.situation: A coworker explains how to use the copy machine and coffee maker.
lessons.goalKr: 사무 기기의 간단한 사용법 설명을 들을 수 있다.

lessons.name: Office Rules
lessons.goalEn: Can read and understand basic office rules and signs.
lessons.situation: You read the office building rules posted on the bulletin board.
lessons.goalKr: 기본적인 사무실 규칙과 표지판을 읽고 이해할 수 있다.

lessons.name: I Need Some Supplies
lessons.goalEn: Can ask for basic office supplies.
lessons.situation: You need supplies for a meeting but don't know where they are kept.
lessons.goalKr: 기본적인 사무용품을 요청할 수 있다.

lessons.name: My Desk, My Space
lessons.goalEn: Can describe your workspace and what's on your desk.
lessons.situation: You video call a friend and describe your new office workspace.
lessons.goalKr: 자신의 작업 공간과 책상 위를 설명할 수 있다.

lessons.name: Setting Up Shop
lessons.goalEn: Can navigate the office, use equipment, and describe your workspace.
lessons.situation: Comprehensive review: giving directions, explaining equipment, describing your desk.
lessons.goalKr: 사무실 내를 돌아다니고, 기기를 사용하며, 작업 공간을 설명할 수 있다.

chapters.description: Learn to talk about your daily work schedule, tell time, describe what you do at work, and discuss simple plans.

lessons.name: What Time Is It?
lessons.goalEn: Can understand when someone talks about time and schedules.
lessons.situation: Your manager tells you about today's schedule and meeting times.
lessons.goalKr: 시간과 일정에 대한 대화를 들을 수 있다.

lessons.name: Today's Schedule
lessons.goalEn: Can read a simple daily work schedule.
lessons.situation: You look at the team schedule board to see what's planned for the day.
lessons.goalKr: 간단한 하루 일정을 읽을 수 있다.

lessons.name: My Typical Day
lessons.goalEn: Can describe your daily work routine.
lessons.situation: A coworker asks what your typical workday looks like.
lessons.goalKr: 매일의 업무 루틴을 설명할 수 있다.

lessons.name: Are You Free Tomorrow?
lessons.goalEn: Can talk about simple future plans and availability.
lessons.situation: A coworker wants to have lunch together. You check your schedule.
lessons.goalKr: 간단한 일정과 가용 시간에 대해 말할 수 있다.

lessons.name: Time Management
lessons.goalEn: Can discuss schedules, routines, and availability confidently.
lessons.situation: Coordinate a team lunch: discuss schedules, check availability, set a time.
lessons.goalKr: 일정, 루틴, 가용 시간에 대해 자신 있게 말할 수 있다.

lessons.name: What Do You Do?
lessons.goalEn: Can understand when someone talks about their job responsibilities.
lessons.situation: During a team meeting, each person describes what they do.
lessons.goalKr: 업무 내용에 대한 대화를 들을 수 있다.

lessons.name: Job Descriptions
lessons.goalEn: Can read simple job descriptions and understand the main duties.
lessons.situation: You read job postings on the company intranet to understand different roles.
lessons.goalKr: 간단한 직무 내용을 읽고 주요 업무를 이해할 수 있다.

lessons.name: I'm Working on It
lessons.goalEn: Can talk about what you are doing now at work.
lessons.situation: Your manager asks what you're currently working on.
lessons.goalKr: 지금 하고 있는 일에 대해 말할 수 있다.

lessons.name: See You Tomorrow!
lessons.goalEn: Can say goodbye and talk about tomorrow's plan.
lessons.situation: It's the end of the workday. You say goodbye to your coworkers.
lessons.goalKr: 작별 인사를 하고 내일 일정에 대해 말할 수 있다.

lessons.name: A Day in the Life
lessons.goalEn: Can describe a full workday from arrival to departure.
lessons.situation: Describe your entire workday to a friend: what you do, current projects, end-of-day plans.
lessons.goalKr: 출근부터 퇴근까지 하루 업무를 설명할 수 있다.

chapters.description: Learn to make polite requests, ask for help, offer assistance, and handle simple workplace problems.

lessons.name: Can You Help Me?
lessons.goalEn: Can understand simple requests for help at work.
lessons.situation: Coworkers ask you for small favors throughout the day.
lessons.goalKr: 직장에서 간단한 도움 요청 표현을 들을 수 있다.

lessons.name: The Request Email
lessons.goalEn: Can read a simple email asking for something.
lessons.situation: You receive an email from your manager with a simple request.
lessons.goalKr: 부탁하는 간단한 이메일을 읽고 이해할 수 있다.

lessons.name: I Need a Hand
lessons.goalEn: Can ask a coworker for simple help.
lessons.situation: You're having trouble with the printer and need a coworker's help.
lessons.goalKr: 동료에게 간단한 도움을 요청할 수 있다.

lessons.name: Sure, No Problem!
lessons.goalEn: Can accept or politely decline a request.
targetPatterns: Sorry, I'm a little busy right now.
lessons.situation: Different coworkers ask you for help. You accept some and politely decline others.
lessons.goalKr: 요청을 수락하거나 정중하게 거절할 수 있다.

lessons.name: Happy to Help
lessons.goalEn: Can make and respond to workplace requests confidently.
lessons.situation: Role-play: handle multiple requests in one busy morning.
lessons.goalKr: 직장에서의 요청과 응답을 자신 있게 할 수 있다.

lessons.name: There's a Problem
lessons.goalEn: Can understand when someone describes a simple workplace problem.
targetPatterns: I think there's a problem with ___.
lessons.situation: Your coworker calls IT support to report a problem. You listen to the call.
lessons.goalKr: 간단한 직장 문제 설명을 들을 수 있다.

lessons.name: The Maintenance Notice
lessons.goalEn: Can read a simple office notice about maintenance or repairs.
lessons.situation: A notice is posted: the elevator will be closed for maintenance this week.
lessons.goalKr: 유지보수 및 수리에 관한 간단한 공지를 읽을 수 있다.

lessons.name: Something's Wrong
lessons.goalEn: Can explain a simple problem at work.
lessons.pronunciation: Stress in negative contractions (can't, isn't, don't)
lessons.situation: Your computer isn't working. You call IT to explain the problem.
lessons.goalKr: 직장의 간단한 문제를 설명할 수 있다.

lessons.name: Let Me Help You
lessons.goalEn: Can offer help and give simple solutions.
lessons.situation: A new coworker is struggling. You offer help and walk them through a solution.
lessons.goalKr: 도움을 제안하거나 간단한 해결책을 제시할 수 있다.

lessons.name: Problem Solved!
lessons.goalEn: Can report problems, offer help, and find solutions at work.
lessons.situation: A busy day with multiple small problems: printer jams, schedule mix-ups, lost supplies.
lessons.goalKr: 문제 보고, 도움 제안, 해결책 제시를 할 수 있다.

chapters.description: Learn basic phone manners, simple email writing, taking messages, and confirming information in writing.

lessons.name: Who's Calling?
lessons.goalEn: Can understand a simple phone call at work.
lessons.situation: The office phone rings. Listen to who is calling and what they want.
lessons.goalKr: 직장에서의 간단한 전화를 들을 수 있다.

lessons.name: You've Got Mail
lessons.goalEn: Can read and understand a simple work email.
lessons.situation: You open your inbox and read a short email from your manager about tomorrow's meeting.
lessons.goalKr: 간단한 업무 이메일을 읽고 이해할 수 있다.

lessons.name: Hello, This Is...
lessons.goalEn: Can answer the phone and identify yourself.
lessons.situation: The phone rings at your desk. Answer it professionally and help the caller.
lessons.goalKr: 전화를 받아 자신의 이름을 말할 수 있다.

lessons.name: Can I Take a Message?
lessons.goalEn: Can take and leave a simple phone message.
lessons.situation: A call comes in for your manager who is in a meeting. Take a message.
lessons.goalKr: 간단한 전화 메시지를 받거나 남길 수 있다.

lessons.name: Ring Ring!
lessons.goalEn: Can handle basic phone conversations at work.
lessons.situation: A morning of phone calls: answer, transfer, take messages, call back.
lessons.goalKr: 기본적인 전화 응대를 할 수 있다.

lessons.name: Please Confirm
lessons.goalEn: Can understand when someone confirms details by phone or email.
lessons.situation: A colleague calls to confirm the time and place for tomorrow's meeting.
lessons.goalKr: 전화나 이메일로 세부 사항을 확인하는 대화를 들을 수 있다.

lessons.name: Reply All
lessons.goalEn: Can read an email thread and follow the conversation.
lessons.situation: Read a short email thread between your manager and a client about a schedule change.
lessons.goalKr: 이메일 주고받기를 읽고 대화 흐름을 따라갈 수 있다.

lessons.name: Short and Sweet
lessons.goalEn: Can compose a simple reply email out loud.
lessons.situation: Your tutor reads you an email. You compose your reply out loud.
lessons.goalKr: 간단한 답장 이메일 내용을 구두로 작성할 수 있다.

lessons.name: I'm Sorry, Could You Repeat That?
lessons.goalEn: Can ask someone to repeat or clarify information.
lessons.situation: On a phone call, you can't hear clearly. Ask the caller to repeat and spell things.
lessons.goalKr: 상대방에게 다시 말해 달라고 하거나 확인을 요청할 수 있다.

lessons.name: Staying Connected
lessons.goalEn: Can handle basic phone and email communication at work.
lessons.situation: Final simulation: receive a call, take a message, read an email, compose a reply, confirm details.
lessons.goalKr: 기본적인 전화와 이메일 커뮤니케이션을 할 수 있다.
